headline: 3 detained after Salman Muqtadir’s studio attacked over land dispute
summary: Content creator Salman Muqtadir's 'Brownfish' studio was vandalised by a group of attackers. Police have detained three suspects in connection to the incident.
details: Content creator Salman Muqtadir's 'Brownfish' studio was attacked and vandalised by a group of people. The studio, which serves as his production house, {// a bit of too much detail, let's keep it simple} was left in ruins with equipment and furniture destroyed.

While some reports suggest the attack was triggered by a husband's refusal to pay extortion money, other sources, including the police, state the incident was rooted in a land dispute involving the building owner.

Salman Muqtadir emphasized in a video that his studio was 'destroyed' and described the attack as unacceptable. Fellow content creator Sadia Axman also expressed her shock and the attack as something that cannot be accepted.
Police have detained three individuals in connection with the attack. Investigations are ongoing to identify and and identify other suspects involved in the incident.

headline: 254 people detained in Cumilla drive against teen gangs
summary: Police from 18 stations and the Detective Branch conducted raids across the district to curb growing gang culture and harassment.
details: Police detained 254 people during a district-wide drive against teen gangs in Cumilla yesterday evening.
The operation was carried out by police from all 18 police stations and the district Detective Branch (DB) across various parts of the city and district.
The raids, which lasted from evening until midnight, were conducted under the instructions of Cumilla Superintendent of Police Md Anisuzzaman, PPM.
Officers targeted locations with previous complaints of harassment and nuisance by teenagers, as well as known crime-prone areas.
The detained individuals are currently being screened to identify those involved in criminal activities, with legal action promised for offenders.
District police stated that these drives are conducted regularly to prevent teenagers from entering a life of crime and to address the rising gang culture.
caption:
254 people detained in a single evening. Cumilla police launch massive crackdown on teen gangs.

Police detained 254 people during a district-wide drive against teen gangs in Cumilla yesterday evening.

The operation was carried out by police from all 18 police stations and the district Detective Branch (DB) across various parts of the city and district.

The raids, which lasted from evening until midnight, were conducted under the instructions of Cumilla Superintendent of Police Md Anisuzzaman, PPM.

Officers targeted locations with previous complaints of harassment and nuisance by teenagers, as well as known crime-prone areas.

The detained individuals are currently being screened to identify those involved in criminal activities, with legal action promised for offenders.

District police stated that these drives are conducted regularly to prevent teenagers from entering a life of crime and to address the rising gang culture.
